author: reek
body: The canonical "hello triangle" -- but rasterized from Codex [Device] AST. One GPU thread per pixel evaluates the three edge functions of a rotating triangle, tests whether the pixel is inside, and Gouraud-interpolates the three vertex colours (red, green, blue) by barycentric weights. This is the reference site's "triangle" technique done as a compute rasterizer -- the geometry step is real Codex, not a fixed-function vertex stage.

author: reek
body: Integer fixed-point throughout: vertices in pixels, edge functions and barycentric weights are exact integer areas.

author: reek
body: Edge function: twice the signed area of triangle (a, b, p). Inside the triangle iff the three edge functions share a sign.
